column2: How many days of annual leave do I get?
column6: Full-time employees receive 21 working days of paid annual leave per year after completing 6 months of service. Employees who have completed 10 years of service, or who are over 50 years old, receive 30 working days.

column2: How much is the overtime rate on Fridays?
column6: Work on Fridays is paid at 200% of the normal hourly rate.

column2: How many days per week can I work remotely?
